items.title: LIAM Denies Agents’ Claims Medical Insurance Products To Be Withdrawn January 2027
items.summary: LIAM says MediAsas won’t be the only option, denying insurance agents’ claim that ITOs will withdraw existing medical insurance/takaful products on Jan 1, 2027. At least one insurer, GE, will stop accepting new applications for individual medical products. The post LIAM Denies Agents’ Claims Medical Insurance Products To Be Withdrawn January 2027 appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MediAsas: Affordable Assurance Means Little Without Affordable Health Care
items.summary: We cannot build affordable medical assurance on top of an unaffordable health care system. There is no evidence that MediAsas will halt future premium increase. The government must confront the more difficult issue of making health care itself affordable. The post MediAsas: Affordable Assurance Means Little Without Affordable Health Care appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: Doctors deciding whether to build their careers in public service should be able to count on proper supervision and fair pay for the work they are already doing. The post MMA Calls For Fair On-Call Pay For Pre-Gazettement Doctors — MMA appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Private Hospitals, Specialists Face Different Insurer Empanelment Rules: IHH CEO
items.summary: IHH Healthcare Malaysia CEO Dr Kamal Amzan says insurers use different criteria to empanel private hospitals and specialists. Some insurance companies cover all doctors at their panel hospitals, whereas others impose tiered arrangements. items.title: National O&G Service Desperately Seeks Doctors For Temporary Sabah Deployment
items.summary: The national head of O&G services urges peninsula-based medical officers to volunteer for temporary and time-bound deployment to Sabah because nearly all public hospitals in the state providing O&G services are running at below 50% of required MO numbers. The post National O&G Service Desperately Seeks Doctors For Temporary Sabah Deployment appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: UK’s Generational Tobacco Ban Set For January 2027
items.summary: The UK's generational smoking ban will come into force on Jan 1, 2027, making it illegal to sell tobacco to anyone born on or after Jan 1, 2009. Vapes and other nicotine products are banned for minors aged <18. The UK plans new rules for nicotine pouches. The post UK’s Generational Tobacco Ban Set For January 2027 appeared first on CodeBlue .
